environment.description: Node.js Express API gateway running in a standard Docker container (node:18-slim) on ECS Fargate. The gRPC backend UserService trusts metadata headers from the gateway, specifically checking 'x-admin-role' metadata key for admin authorization and 'x-authenticated-user' for identity. No service mesh or header filtering between gateway and backend. Container runs as root with default capabilities.

config.network: Direct TCP connectivity between gateway and gRPC backend on port 50051
config.grpc_backend_auth: Metadata-based trust (no mTLS, no token validation)
